title: StellarFleet opportunity scratchpad
content:
Context:
- Prospect: StellarFleet Logistics (mid-market freight broker + TMS provider). HQ: Chicago. ~220 employees, Series B (2024).
- Why they matter: heavy real-time routing + ETA prediction + customer chat ops. Lots of tokenized text (driver notes, customs, exception handling) and waveform->text items. Good fit for inference cost reduction + latency guarantees.

Quick hypothesis on pain:
- Real-time chat for shippers and drivers suffers from slow replies and rate limits from current ML vendor.
- They tried self-hosting but ops overhead + spike handling caused late deliveries.
- Want predictable cost to justify multi-region edge routing for customers across NA.

Where Redwood could land value:
- Replace current hosted model for customer chat with Redwood Hosted API first for fast pilot (no infra lift) -> show latency savings and 15-30% cost reduction via batching and prefix caching.
- Next step: Dedicated pool for predictable throughput during morning dispatch surge; SLA for max p95 latency.
- Long-term: Private deployment for compliance on certain enterprise customers (insurance/shippers).

Pilot proposal (45 day):
- Week 0: data hookup + sample set (~50k tokens/day) + SLOs discussion (target p95 <200ms for short prompts).
- Week 1-2: A/B traffic 10% vs current provider on non-critical flows (driver Q&A). Measure latency, token cost, hallucination rate on curated eval set.
- Week 3-4: Expand traffic to 30-50% + run model quantization suggestion from Redwood Optimize; show unit cost impact.
- Week 5-6: Wrap-up, ROI deck, next-step contract (Dedicated reservation sizing).

Success metrics (what we'll show them):
- p95 latency improvement (baseline -> Redwood)
- tokens/month and cost delta (normalized per 1k requests)
- percentage decrease in human escalation (pilot tracked via support label)
- throughput headroom (requests/sec) at peak times

Key stakeholders to target (notes from LinkedIn):
- CTO: Maria Cortez — cares about cost predictability and infra.
- Head of Ops: Daniel Rios — cares about dispatch reliability.
- Product lead (chat): Aaron Blake — cares about response quality and LLM regressions.
- Security/compliance: VP Risk: Claire Dunlop (may push for private deployment).

Outbound messaging (short sequence drafts):
1) LinkedIn connection (initial):
Hi Maria — I’m Lena at Redwood Inference. We help fleets like LoadPort and FleetWave reduce LLM unit cost and hit sub-200ms p95 for driver chat features. Would love 10 min to share a pilot blueprint specific to logistics ops.

2) Cold email (subject: Pilot: lower chat latency during dispatch surge)
Hey Maria — quick intro: Redwood builds a production-first inference platform that teams use to lower per-token cost and keep sub-200ms p95 latency during peak dispatch. We recently cut a freight company's chat cost by ~28% while improving p95 by 40ms. Can I share a 3-slide pilot plan tailored to StellarFleet?
CTA: 15 min next week.

3) Follow-up if no response (2 days):
Re: Pilot: lower chat latency — Maria, any chance you can point me to the right person for driver/chat infra? If helpful I can send a short video + ROI calc.

Objection handling cheat sheet (short):
- "We already have a provider": acknowledge + ask what they’re seeing in peak hours; offer a non-disruptive A/B pilot on non-critical routes.
- "Security concerns / data in cloud": propose Dedicated or Private options; mention KMS/HSM integration and audit logs.
- "Cost not a priority": pivot to reliability and predictability; show how reserved Dedicated capacity reduces variance in monthly spend.
- "Integration effort": emphasize same API surface as hosted + SDKs, suggest Redwood SE for 2-week integration sprint.

Tactical notes / TODOs:
- FIND: sample API logs from them (ask initial contact for a sanitized 24h request trace).
- BUILD: short demo with their brand name in UI + 2 sample dialogs (driver delay, customs hold).
- ASK: legal for MSA template for Pilot (cc: Samir).
- RUN: quick cost model (Mei to run token-cost calc vs their reported spend).

Pricing anchor (brainstorm):
- Pilot: $0 (credit) for 45 days up to 500k tokens; Redwood measures metrics and shows ROI.
- If positive: Dedicated minimal commitment: 4 GPUs reserved monthly, estimated $X/mo (TBD after traffic profile).
- Optional: Private on-prem pricing annex for enterprise customers (add 20–35% to cover infra ops).

Risks / unknowns:
- Their current model / tokenization approach (need sample).
- Spike patterns — do they have predictable morning surge or chaotic bursts?
- Internal procurement timelines (may require legal + security signoff).

Conversation snippets to test in demo (A/B):
- Driver: "ETA delayed — why?" vs system prompt that includes cached route context (tests prefix caching).
- Shipper: short policy Q (bedrock of hallucination test) — measure factuality/regression.

Notes to self: keep outreach light, focus on operations reliability angle rather than pure cost. Use quantification in all outreach (percentages, ms, token counts). Schedule quick prep with Samir + Mei before first outreach.

Referenced internal tickets / resources:
- GROW-1187: StellarFleet account intro (sales notes)
- Confluence page: pilot checklist (link above)
- Slack: #logistics-outreach thread (invite Samir)

Next steps (today):
- Draft email + 1-pager for Maria (send to Samir for review) — due EOD.
preview: Personal scratchpad for StellarFleet logistics outbound; pilot plan + messaging + objections
